service.description: Add a user to a tenant with a tenant-scoped role. Writes UserGroupMember and TenantUserPermissionGroupMember atomically — never one without the other.

parameter.name: permissionUserGroupId
parameter.description: One of the assignable tenant roles (DARPAN_TENANT_ADMIN, DARPAN_TENANT_USER, DARPAN_COMPANY_EDITOR, DARPAN_COMPANY_VIEW_ONLY).

parameter.name: ok
parameter.description: True when the member was added.

service.description: Change a member's tenant role: thruDate the old permission row, create the new one.

parameter.name: ok
parameter.description: True when the role was changed.

service.description: Remove a user from a tenant: thruDate both membership entities (no row deletes) and clear the user's active-tenant preference when it pointed at the removed tenant.

parameter.name: tenantUserGroupId
parameter.description: Tenant to remove the member from.

parameter.name: ok
parameter.description: True when the member was removed.
